description: Source file implementing string utility functions for trimming, splitting, converting, and comparing strings, as well as safe string copying and integer parsing.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace and additional characters from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace and additional characters from a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes both leading and trailing whitespace and additional characters from a string.

methods.name: ltrimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring starting from the first non-whitespace character.

methods.name: rtrimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring ending at the last non-whitespace character.

methods.name: trimmed_substr
methods.description: Returns the substring between the first and last non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a string is empty or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: bool_str
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'true' or 'false' string.

methods.name: str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter.

methods.name: stoi
methods.description: Converts a string to int64_t with logging for errors.

methods.name: int_to_hex_string
methods.description: Converts an unsigned int to a zero-padded hexadecimal string of specified length.

methods.name: bytes_string_to_string
methods.description: Converts a hex-encoded string to its ASCII string representation.

methods.name: copy_string
methods.description: Safely copies a C-string into a buffer with overflow check.

methods.name: endswith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.
